texts.orig: All the computed mode frequencies were real. Absence of modes with imaginary frequency clearly shows that all the compounds studied here are dynamically stable. E ð 1 Þ g ; E ð 2 Þ g , and E ð 3 Þ g modes correspond to motion of Y, X (X ¼ F, Cl), and O atoms, respectively, in case of YOF, YOCl whereas in case of YOBr, YOI these modes correspond to displacement of the X (X ¼ Br, I), Y, and O atoms. Similarly the vibrational modes A ð 1 Þ 1 g ; A ð 2 Þ 1 g and A ð 3 Þ 1 g belong to the antisymmetric vibration of Y, F, and O atoms, respectively, in case of YOF, whereas in case of YOX (Cl, Br, I) A ð 1 Þ 1 g and A ð 2 Þ 1 g modes correspond to antisymmetric vibration of Y and X (Cl, Br, and I). The B2 g mode corresponds to antisymmetric vibration of O atoms.
